discovery_logic: Registry-driven matching via agent-matcher subagent. SCP messages carry from/to for routing. Blackboard used for shared state. Generator script creates new entries from template. 100+ new micro-specialists added in feature/100-subagent-expansion branch.
notes: Expanded with 100 new diverse subagent specializations (different tasks). Many have .md definitions in subagents/<category>/. Use the generator script for any remaining. Run $subswarm on the feature branch to test.
